400.title: ENGIE Acquires 438 MW Battery Energy Storage Project in Poland
400.summary: ENGIE Zielona Energia, a subsidiary of the French utility company ENGIE that operates as a provider and producer of renewable energy in Poland, has acquired a special purpose vehicle developing a 438 MW/876 MWh battery energy storage project.The project, located in Trebaczew in Dzialoszyn municipality, was initially developed by Mithra Energy and Futureal Investment Partners, a member of Futureal Group.
400.body: ENGIE Zielona Energia, a subsidiary of the French utility company ENGIE that operates as a provider and producer of renewable energy in Poland, has acquired a special purpose vehicle developing a 438 MW/876 MWh battery energy storage project.The project, located in Trebaczew in Dzialoszyn municipality, was initially developed by Mithra Energy and Futureal Investment Partners, a member of Futureal Group. According to the company, the project is expected to facilitate power evacuation, reduce pressure on local transmission infrastructure, and improve the reliability of electricity supply in the region.The acquisition follows ENGIE's investment in a 250 MW/1,000 MWh battery storage project in Tursk Wielki in Poland's Swietokrzyskie Voivodeship.

600.title: Sostegni narrowly misses bronze. A bitter European Championship in Poland.
600.summary: Just over three seconds separated Leonardo Sostegni from the bronze medal in the Coxless Four at the Under-23 European Rowing Championships.
600.body: Just over three seconds separated Leonardo Sostegni from the bronze medal in the Coxless Four at the Under-23 European Rowing Championships. The Canottieri Limite athlete, sailing with Jacopo Cappagli (Sampierdarena), Filippo Angella (Tirrenia Todaro), and Lorenzo Cracco (Varese), crossed the finish line in 6:38.46, making up two places in the final 500 meters of the race, having already moved up to sixth place at the 1500-meter mark, behind Germany and Croatia. However, the Italian crew failed to make up ground, taking third place to Poland, and gold to Denmark and gold to Romania. Given the wind, shortly before the start of the finals, the lanes were reassigned based on the qualifying times, and unfortunately, Sostegni and his teammates ended up in the most exposed one, with difficult conditions for rowing, at least until the final 500 meters when the Italians began their comeback.
